name:
B10-0294/2025 (S&D
Verts/ALE) – Dissolution of political parties and the crackdown on the opposition in Mali
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the dissolution of political parties and the crackdown on the opposition in Mali
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and calling on Mali's military rulers to undo their crackdown on the opposition. It asks them to reverse the decision to dissolve all political parties, scrap the plan to give General Assimi Goïta five more years in power without an election, set an election date, and release people held for political reasons. It also asks the European Union to help restore democracy in Mali.

- Nothing changes yet; the Parliament only asks Mali's rulers to act.
- It affects Mali's opposition parties, arrested activists and voters.
- Next, the European Union and member states are urged to press Mali's authorities.
